title: Government letter to the British Business Bank
text: A letter from the Chancellor and Business and Trade Secretary to the British Business Bank setting out the government’s priorities following a £2 billion funding uplift at Budget. It asks the Bank to sharpen the focus of its investment activity on regional growth, reindustrialisation, and the UK’s security and strategic capabilities. Up to £900 million is expected to support defence and dual-use technologies.
